VeraGridEngine.Utils.Filtering.results_table_filtering.results_table_value_to_search_text(table: ResultsTable, value: object) → str[source]

Build the searchable text for one results-table value.

Both the raw value and the value formatted as shown by ResultsModel are included so a user can search for the exact text visible in the table.

Parameters:

  • table – Results table that defines the display precision.

  • value – Cell value to convert.

Returns:

Case-normalized searchable text.

VeraGridEngine.Utils.Filtering.results_table_filtering.search_results_table(table: ResultsTable, text: str) → ResultsTable[source]

Search row labels, column labels, and displayed cell values.

Matching rows retain all columns to preserve the context of the result. A query matching only column labels retains all rows for those columns.

Parameters:

  • table – Source results table.

  • text – Free-text query.

Returns:

Sliced results table containing every matching row or column.
